translations.web: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
translations.bsb: A leader who lacks judgment is also a great oppressor, but he who hates dishonest profit will prolong his days.
translations.kjv: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
translations.asv: The prince that lacketh understanding is also a great oppressor; But he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
